verdict.rationale: Circle Mint supports USD↔USDC conversion at no additional cost, and CPN offers real-time FX quotes with cross-border payouts settling in USDC, but there's no documented API for generic quote-then-execute conversion flows with explicit fees/settlement times exposed as a first-class quotes/conversions endpoint akin to a dedicated conversion API. missing for 10: a unified quotes API returning rate/fee/settlement-time before execution, documented fee schedules for stablecoin-to-stablecoin or fiat-to-stablecoin conversions, and independent corroboration of conversion API behavior in production.
